summary: Solid Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $200 million of common stock through Jefferies as sales agent. This replaces a prior ATM with $6,447 unsold, and adds $199,993,553 in new capacity. Jefferies earns up to 3.0% commission. No specific price, shares, or timing were set. The filing is routine capital-raising, not a special situation. What to watch: market overhang from potential sales under this ATM facility.
